free_text: 67 y/o male, PSA 6.0, PI-RADS 4, prior negative biopsy. Repeat targeted biopsy indicated due to PI-RADS 4 lesion and rising PSA, despite low PSA density (0.08). Low PSA density supports tolerance for waiting, but the lesion warrants re-sampling to rule out progression. Alternative plan is surveillance with repeat biopsy in a few years.
